files.content:
# blueprint: a technical drawing on a cyanotype sheet

White line art draws itself on Prussian blue. A pen moves at constant speed, dimension lines grow arrow heads, cut
faces fill with 45 degree hatching, labels type in behind a plotter caret, and one red rubber stamp lands at the end.
The sheet is a brushed cyanotype: uneven coating, a pale ragged brush edge, a fold, paper fibre. Every mark is lit from
behind, with a faint halation, and nothing casts a shadow.

Use it for how-it-works explainers, engineering and design histories, product internals, anything that is a diagram.
Do not use it for photo-led stories, people, or anything that wants warmth: the palette is one blue, one white and one red.

Original to this repo: nothing is read off a reel. The numbers are design choices, written in `taste.json` so another reel
can reuse them. Example: `tastes/blueprint/demo` ("Camera obscura", how a pinhole makes an image, 18 s).

## The numbers (all sizes at 1080 wide)

| | |
|---|---|
| Format | 9:16, 30 fps, 12-20 s, beats 54-150 frames, one detail iris per reel |
| Sheet | deep `#0a2a55`, mid `#12427f`, light `#2468b0`, bare paper `#e6eef2` at the edge; made by one shader (`Sheet`), no scan |
| Drawing | line `#f2f8ff`, thin lines and notes `#a9c8e8`, the stamp `#ff6a4d` (the only other colour) |
| Line weights | object 5.5 px, thin 2.4 px, hatch 1.6 px; centre line dash-dot 38 / 9 / 5 / 9 |
| Pen | constant speed, no easing: object 30 px/f, thin 46 px/f, hatch 120 px/f; a dot on the tip while it moves |
| Type | Barlow Condensed caps (titles 0.185 W, tags 0.035 W, stamps weight 800), IBM Plex Mono for figures and notes (0.03 W) |
| Write-on | labels type at 1.4 characters a frame behind a block caret; titles are swept in by a plotter bar at 0.05 W/f |
| Light | halation radius 0.0046 W at 0.55; line erosion 0.25 (a pit pattern re-rolled on twos); no shadows |
| Camera | slow push only, 0.03 then 0.17 scale, `inOutCubic`, pivot on the drawing; no shake, no drift |
| Cuts | lamp flash (10 f, screen blend, alpha 0.8) at the start; detail iris (22 f, `inOutCubic`) out of a callout circle |
| Rhythm | a new element every 8-14 frames; order: lines, dimensions, labels, stamp; hold 0.6-1 s after the last label |
| Photos | `Cyanotype`: gradient map `#04152e` > `#0a2a55` > `#4f8fd0` > `#e9f4ff`, contrast 1.15, halation 0.25; never a tint over colour |
| Sound | A minor at 72 bpm, -22.6 dBFS RMS bed; effects +3 to +6 dB over it; mix -14.7 LUFS, -2.8 dBTP |

## Rules

- The sheet is blue and the drawing is light. The stamp is the only other colour, and it is used once or twice.
- Lines are drawn, never faded in. Fades are for the sheet's grid and the end of the reel.
- One pen at a time for the main line work; dimensions and labels may overlap the end of a stroke.
- Hatch only cut faces. Dimension every drawing at least twice. Put a figure in the gap of a long dimension line, beside a short one.
- Light type on the sheet only; there is no dark-on-light beat.
- One text move at a time: a label types or a title sweeps, not both.
- Every `<Layer>` id is unique (the sheet is `bp-sheet-<seed>`; give a second sheet another `seed`).

## Components (`import ... from 'tastes/blueprint/index.js'`)

| | |
|---|---|
| `Sheet {seed, vignette, exposure, hold}` | the cyanotype sheet; grain re-rolls every `hold` (2) frames |
| `Ink {id, chalk, halo}` | one layer for a whole drawing: erodes the line edge, adds the halation. Put strokes and labels inside |
| `Stroke {d, at, kind, speed, tip, fill}` | a path put on by the pen (`kind` `object` / `thin` / `hatch`); `penFrames(d, kind)` gives its length in frames, so strokes chain |
| `CentreLine {a, b, at}` | a dash-dot line drawn on |
| `Dim {a, b, off, text, at}` | a dimension: extension lines, a line with a head at each end, the figure typed in |
| `Callout {cx, cy, r, letter, at}` | a circle round a place, a leader and a lettered bubble |
| `Border {at}`, `Grid {at}` | the sheet's rule with quarter ticks, and the faint printed grid |
| `Typed`, `Plot`, `Stamp` | a typed label, a swept title, the red rubber stamp |
| `TitleBlock {x, y, w, h, cells, cols, at}` | the corner table: frame and rules drawn, cells type in |
| `Push`, `Flash`, `DetailIris` | the camera push, the lamp flash, the circular detail cut |
| `Cyanotype {id}` | prints any picture or footage as a cyanotype |
| helpers | `lineD`, `polyD`, `rectD`, `circleD`, `headD`, `hatchD` (a rectangle), `hatchPolyD` (a convex face) return path data in page px (1080 x 1920) |

All geometry is in page px and scales with the composition. Put it inside one `Ink`.

## Sound

`tools/sfx.py <dir>` writes the effects, `tools/score.py <out.wav>` the bed; both are numpy only, fixed seeds, nothing
third-party. Link or copy the output into the project's `public/sfx/`.

| Picture event | File | Offset (frames) | Level over the bed |
|---|---|---|---|
| lamp comes on (first frame) | `lamp` | 0 | +5 dB |
| a pen draws an object line | `pen` (0.5 s tiles) | -1 | +4 dB |
| a pen draws hatching | `hatch` | -1 | +4.5 dB |
| the plotter sweeps a title | `plot` | 0 | +4 dB |
| dimension heads pop | `tick` | 0 | +4 dB |
| a label types | `key0-2`, one per second character | 0 | +4.5 dB |
| the stamp lands | `stamp` | -2 | +6 dB |
| the detail iris opens | `iris` | 0 | +5 dB |
| fade to black | `end` | -16 | +4 dB |

Check a mix with `kinetograph audio analyze demo/index.tsx`: the demo reads -14.7 LUFS and -2.8 dBTP.

## Make a reel in it

1. List the drawing's parts: outlines, cut faces, dimensions, two or three labels, one thing to stamp.
2. Lay them out in page px, title in the top third, the drawing in the middle, dimensions and title block below.
3. Chain the strokes with `penFrames`, push the camera once, and cut to a detail with `DetailIris` if there is one.
4. Place the sounds from the table, run `audio analyze`, and look at a strip of frames before rendering.

Fonts load from Google Fonts (see `demo/public/CREDITS.md`). The demo needs `public/sfx/` (the files above and `score.wav`).

## Installed with `kinetograph add`
